name: Titan X
_notes: Transcribed from sheet EU3144 (Lv I-IX), Toying trait card EX3219, AI ER3145-ER3165, BP ES3176-ES3195, Feints ER3166-ER3175, Storybook p.178-179 setup.
Mnestis: win by filling the Wound Stack (sheet wounds 12-17); the Battle Track table is campaign-only.
Ω = RAGE, Ψ = FATE, the Pain-set icon gate = PAIN N+ (Pain tokens).
Man Among Sheep: the engine's "Primordial Round" is used as Titan X's AI at the start of the Titan Round (no Hold On / Primordial Round triggers). Death of Hope at the end of the Titan Round.
Knockback "to the left" = to the left of Titan X's facing.

traits.Toying: Apply the following modifiers to all Titan X Attacks: -1 EVADE_DICE and -1 DANGER per hit (minimum 1). As long as this Trait is active, the Death of Hope Trait is disabled.
traits.Killjoy: Killjoy: Permanently lose 1 equipped Gear card. Triggers when prompted and each time a Titan performs a Full Evade or reduces all DANGER from an Attack to 0.
traits.Death of Hope: End of Titan Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Faster Than Thought: If, during Targeting, there is a tie, the AI or Signature becomes Simultaneous and Targets all tied Titans, in random order.
traits.Man Among Sheep: This Battle does not have a Primordial Round. During the Titan Round, Titan X goes first by drawing and performing an AI card. If there are 5+ cards in the Wound Stack, Titan X draws and performs another AI card after the first 2 Titan turns. Important: For the purpose of this trait, treat dead Titans as empty turns. In other words, a dead Titan still counts as a Titan for the 2 Titan turns limit.
traits.Unholy Halo: The Battle takes place on a plate of Atlantean hardlight, with its center around Titan X. Consequently, Titan X does not 'recognize' Board Edges, for them, the Battle Board is infinite. For Argonaut Titans, the edges are Boundless. Whenever Titan X would move 'beyond' the Board Edge, stop them at the last space of the Battle Board and move all other Titans in the opposite direction the remaining number of spaces. If a Titan would end outside of the Battle Board in this way, they have fallen off the hardlight plate and drowned (died). Note: Demeter does not work here!
traits.Flash Step: Flash Step: Titan X moves to the Target or the Attacker, continues to move past them in a straight line for 8 spaces, then turns to face them. If Flash Step was performed as part of an Attack, proceed to the Evasion Roll only after you have finished the move. For the purposes of that Attack, Titan X is considered to be adjacent; you are not considered adjacent to Titan X. Flash Step does not cause crash against the Target, but causes crash against any other Titan. Flash Step triggers only when prompted.
traits.Feints: Titan X employs various traps, feints and ruses to destroy the Argonauts. Feint: Draw and resolve a Feint card. If it's an Effect, immediately resolve it, then discard it. If it's a Status, it remains in play until it is replaced by another Status, then it is discarded (there can be only one Status in play). All discarded Feint cards return to the Feint deck, which should then be shuffled.
traits.Critical Strikes: Each AI card has an additional effect. If a Titan rolls a Crit Evade Fail during their Evasion Roll or Judgement test, Titan X has landed a Critical on you. Apply the Critical effect immediately. Pacify: Permanently lose 1 equipped Weapon Gear card. Deadly Wound: Gain 3 Pain tokens. Mortal Wound: Immediately draw an Obol. Go for the Cryptex: Disable your Cryptex.
traits.No Obstacles: Titan X ignores Line of Sight. When following the Unholy Halo rules, move Terrain tiles just as you would Titans. If any part of a Terrain tile would move beyond a Board Edge, remove that tile entirely, even if Indestructible.
traits.Dazzling Speed: If you're in front of Titan X, you cannot re-roll your Attack or Evasion Dice.
traits.Nemesis Vow: When you draw a Feint card, before it is revealed, each Titan gains 1 Ambrosia token.
traits.Truth of the Shoals: When you gain Pain tokens in any way, double the amount.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Play for Keeps: Play on a half of the Battle Board, i.e. 14x10 spaces (you may fold the Board to denote it).
traits.You Cannot Advance: If, during Targeting, there is no tie, the AI or Signature becomes Simultaneous and Targets all Titans, in random order.
traits.Just Fold: Play on a quarter of the Battle Board, i.e. 7x10 spaces (you may fold the Board to denote it).
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).

feints.name: Junction Seizure
feints.text: When this Feint is drawn, if all Titans have 10+ Pain tokens combined, discard those tokens. Every Titan gains as much DANGER as they discarded Pain tokens. If the Titans don't have 10+ Pain tokens, every Titan gains 2 Pain tokens instead.

feints.name: No Rules
feints.text: When this Feint is drawn, Titan X goes for the Argo. Immediately discard 1 random Argo Ability from the Battle.

feints.name: Met Your Match
feints.text: As long as this Feint is in play, all your Attacks gain: "Full Miss: Pain X, where X is the top BP card's level."

feints.name: Riposte
feints.text: As long as this Feint is in play, all your Attacks gain: "Full Miss: Titan X performs Signature against the Attacker."

feints.name: Feint Injury
feints.text: When this Feint is drawn, Heal 1. Then remove this card from the Feint deck. If this card was drawn as an effect of the AI 0, discard it and draw again.

feints.name: Mind Games
feints.text: When this Feint is drawn, clear the Kratos Pool and place this card in the Kratos Pool. Then, the next time you would place tokens in the Kratos Pool, don't, but discard this card instead. If this card was drawn as an effect of the AI 0, discard it and draw again.

feints.name: Blinding Lights
feints.text: As long as this Feint is in play, and you're in front of Titan X, ignore Opening and Closing tokens.

feints.name: Overstep (I)
feints.text: Shuffle the Overstep BP I card into the BP deck. Then, remove this card from the Feint deck.

feints.name: Unreadable
feints.text: As long as this Feint is in play, draw AI and BP cards from the bottom of the appropriate deck (and not the top). When you wound a BP III, after performing Escalation, shuffle the BP deck.

feints.name: Overstep (II)
feints.text: Shuffle the Overstep BP II card into the BP deck. Then, remove this card from the Feint deck.
